name: yayaw-table-vue
title: YaYaw Table Vue
description: Full-featured Vue 3 data table with filters, URL state, saved views, CRUD forms, bulk actions, inline editing, Kanban, Gallery, and CSV export.

export const createTranslations = (
  locale: string,
  overrides?: DataTableTranslations
): DataTableTranslations => ({
  ...defaultTranslations,
  ...(locale.toLowerCase().startsWith("fr") ? frenchTranslations : {}),
  ...overrides,
});
